name: ncCut2D
author: tmuka
description: Turns a 2D drawing (DXF, SVG, PDF or Illustrator) into router G-code: pick what to cut outside, inside, on the line or as a pocket, with the stock thickness and cut depths; end mills from your Tool Library, speeds and feeds for the material, tabs, and a preview of the cut. Built from ncCAM and ncLaser.
